objectives.statement: Recognize common fixed verb, adjective, and noun plus preposition patterns as single lexical units.
Choose the correct preposition in frequent fixed expressions, even when English uses a different preposition.
Build natural Bokmål sentences with fixed prepositional expressions and a following noun, pronoun, or infinitive phrase.

notes: Must teach fixed verb/adjective/noun plus preposition patterns as lexical units. Warn that these do not map one-to-one to English prepositions.
